en.headline: Tseung Kwan O Park Central hosts Dopamine Dessert Festival this weekend
en.dek: More than 20 popular local dessert shops gather at the mall on 12 and 13 September offering cheesecakes, mochi, cinnamon rolls and other sweets ahead of Mid-Autumn.
body: Tseung Kwan O Park Central is staging a two-day Dopamine Dessert Festival on Saturday and Sunday, bringing together more than 20 local dessert brands under one roof.

Organisers said the event features long-queue favourites including handmade soft-centred Basque cheesecakes from A.Jennbakery, tofu mochi and milk pudding from Mamegumo, cinnamon rolls from Tung² Patisserie, and various cookies and palmiers. Five coffee and drinks brands are also taking part.

The festival runs on 12 and 13 September at the shopping centre near MTR Tseung Kwan O Station Exit B2. A related pet-friendly market is scheduled for the following weekend. The organisers described the gathering as a pre-Mid-Autumn sweet treat for families.

zh.headline: 將軍澳中心本周末辦多巴胺甜品節 逾20店齊集
zh.dek: 9月12至13日於將軍澳中心舉行，雲集手工巴斯克芝士蛋糕、豆腐麻糬、肉桂捲等人氣甜品，為中秋預熱。
body: 將軍澳中心本周六及周日（9月12至13日）舉行「多巴胺甜品節」，逾20間本地人氣甜品店齊集一地。
活動包括A.Jennbakery手工軟心巴斯克芝士蛋糕、Mamegumo豆腐麻糬及牛乳布甸、Tung² Patisserie肉桂捲，以及多款曲奇及蝴蝶酥等。另有五個咖啡及酒品品牌參與。
場地鄰近港鐵將軍澳站B2出口。主辦單位表示，活動為中秋佳節預熱，下周末另有慢活甜寵市集。
